paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.55 as of October 23, representing a 3.77 percent decrease from the prior close and a 43.96 percent decrease over 22 sessions. There have been 2 new news headlines in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi CEO outlining a new financing approach for Project Matador and the stock falling 3.8 percent on insider selling, as reported by Yahoo Finance and MarketBeat, respectively. These headlines are from October 24 and October 23.

There have been various SEC filings, including 4 Form 4 filings and 3 Form 144 filings, with recent filings including an insider transaction report and a notice of proposed sale, as well as an 8-K filing announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement.
